note: A four-word register file - unpacked array, clocked indexed write, combinational indexed read. Used to fail, on hif-backend#87: the array regenerated as a four-bit vector, the array range taken as the width and the element width lost, with the default printed as run-together index/value pairs. Fixed: it prints `reg [7:0] mem [0:3];`, and the reading process is `@(*)` because a memory cannot be in an event list. The corpus has no memory design before this one; structural pipeline only, so it checks the file reparses, not what the memory reads back.
